commit.subject: LU-20438 lnet: Implement LNet support for PCI P2P DMA
commit.message:
LU-20438 lnet: Implement LNet support for PCI P2P DMA

Introduce LNet APIs to query and track PCI P2P DMA support
across network interfaces. This allows LNet to identify
if a peer NI supports P2P DMA mappings.

Test-Parameters: trivial
